htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker You are offline. Some functionality may be unavailable. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker You are offline. Some functionality may be unavailable. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. For all other queries, please see our contact us page Footer Here to help My Plan Help & FAQs Terms & Conditions Privacy & Cookies Policy Privacy centre About Tesco Tesco PLC Careers Contact us Useful links Product recall Store locator Help More from Tesco Groceries Clubcard Tesco.com Tesco Mobile © Tesco.com 2026 All rights reserved SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan end marker

Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker You are offline. Some functionality may be unavailable. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker You are offline. Some functionality may be unavailable. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. For all other queries, please see our contact us page Footer Here to help My Plan Help & FAQs Terms & Conditions Privacy & Cookies Policy Privacy centre About Tesco Tesco PLC Careers Contact us Useful links Product recall Store locator Help More from Tesco Groceries Clubcard Tesco.com Tesco Mobile © Tesco.com 2026 All rights reserved SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan end marker

Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker You are offline. Some functionality may be unavailable. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. For all other queries, please see our contact us page Footer Here to help My Plan Help & FAQs Terms & Conditions Privacy & Cookies Policy Privacy centre About Tesco Tesco PLC Careers Contact us Useful links Product recall Store locator Help More from Tesco Groceries Clubcard Tesco.com Tesco Mobile © Tesco.com 2026 All rights reserved SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan end marker

Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker You are offline. Some functionality may be unavailable. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. For all other queries, please see our contact us page Footer Here to help My Plan Help & FAQs Terms & Conditions Privacy & Cookies Policy Privacy centre About Tesco Tesco PLC Careers Contact us Useful links Product recall Store locator Help More from Tesco Groceries Clubcard Tesco.com Tesco Mobile © Tesco.com 2026 All rights reserved SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan end marker

Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker You are offline. Some functionality may be unavailable. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. For all other queries, please see our contact us page Footer Here to help My Plan Help & FAQs Terms & Conditions Privacy & Cookies Policy Privacy centre About Tesco Tesco PLC Careers Contact us Useful links Product recall Store locator Help More from Tesco Groceries Clubcard Tesco.com Tesco Mobile © Tesco.com 2026 All rights reserved SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan end marker

htmlAfterStep.bodyTextExcerpt: SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan start marker You are offline. Some functionality may be unavailable. Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm. For all other queries, please see our contact us page Footer Here to help My Plan Help & FAQs Terms & Conditions Privacy & Cookies Policy Privacy centre About Tesco Tesco PLC Careers Contact us Useful links Product recall Store locator Help More from Tesco Groceries Clubcard Tesco.com Tesco Mobile © Tesco.com 2026 All rights reserved SR Output Tool VoiceOver scan end marker

Delivery Saver Tesco.com Groceries Sign In Store Locator Contact us Home My Plan FAQs Delivery Saver Priority Christmas slots included with Anytime plan Save £176 on delivery and collection charges* Get a weekly shop delivered? Or prefer Click+Collect? Sign up to Delivery Saver from £2.49 a month and you won’t have to pay for your slot. *Based on one weekly £5 slot compared to a 12-month Anytime plan. Choose a plan that suits the way you shop 6-month plans 12-month plans Most popular Anytime £7.99a month for 6 months £47.94 in total Your shopping, how you want it, when you want it Sign up What’s included Includes same-day delivery* Home Delivery for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot * Doesn't include Whoosh and F&F Clothing Off Peak £4.99a month for 6 months £29.94 in total Take advantage of our less busy delivery slots Sign up What’s included Home Delivery for any available slot after 3pm With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Collection for any available slot Click+Collect £2.49a month for 6 months £14.94 in total Your shopping, picked, packed and ready to collect Sign up What’s included Includes same-day collection Collection for any available slot Early access to Christmas and Easter collection slots With our Delivery Saver guarantee, we’ll give you coupons for the difference if you don’t save on delivery charges Enjoy these Delivery Saver benefits Same-day deliveries Last-minute shop? On our Anytime plan, choose from available same-day slots. Access to more slots Book up to 4 weeks in advance and get priority Christmas slots on our Anytime plan. Never out of pocket With our Delivery Saver guarantee, if you don’t save on delivery and collection charges, we'll give you a coupon for the difference. Collect when you like All of our plans include same-day Click+Collect, which you can pick up any time within your selected timeslot. See the full Delivery Saver terms and conditions Still have questions? We’re trialling the WhatsApp messaging service to answer questions about your Delivery Saver account or our plans. You can send us a message via 0800 917 7403 or wa.me/448009177403 from mobile devices, Monday-Friday 7am-11pm and Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm.
